definition: A number from $0$ to $1$ that measures how likely an event is, written as a fraction, a decimal or a percentage.
A line from $0$ (impossible) to $1$ (certain), with $0.5$ (even chance) in the middle, on which probabilities are marked.
One outcome or a group of outcomes, such as scoring an even number when a dice is rolled.
One possible result of an experiment, such as scoring $4$ when a dice is rolled.
The event that a given event does not happen; its probability is $1$ minus the probability that the event happens.
